description: §5.2 executable-sink rule (S456) controls: interpolation into a relative URL path, after a fixed `https:` or `mailto:` scheme all compile and render; the handler is the unquoted call form.
rationale: §5.2 executable-sink rule refuses only an executable sink: an event attribute WITH `${…}`, `srcdoc` with `${…}`, or a URL whose LITERAL scheme is not one of `http:` / `https:` / `mailto:` / `tel:`. A scheme written literally cannot be changed by the interpolation that follows its `:`. (S464: a quoted event attribute with no `${…}` is now E-ATTR-QUOTED-HANDLER — see quoted-handler-neg — so this control uses the unquoted form `onclick=go(1)`.)
